summary.name: AiMatch
summary.one_liner: AiMatch is a web directory for discovering and comparing AI tools by pricing, API access, use case, and workflow fit.
keywords: find ai tools by use case
use_cases: Finding AI tools for a specific workflow
Comparing AI tools by price and API access
Shortlisting free AI tools before paying
Browsing new AI tools by category
summary.what_it_does: AiMatch is a directory of AI tools, stating it indexes about 4,290 tools. Users can browse by category (such as coding, video, marketing, and audio), filter by pricing and API access, and open a free-tools view. It offers side-by-side comparison pages for finalists. The page also lists recently indexed tools, each with a short description. It links to StackTrim, a separate service for auditing AI subscriptions. The page says new tools are added on a rolling basis.
notable: Directory of about 4,290 AI tools with filters for pricing, API access and use case
Side-by-side comparison pages for shortlisted tools
Rolling additions of newly indexed tools
caveats: Pricing model of the directory itself is not stated on the page
The page recommends StackTrim for subscription audits, which is a separate product
